story.originalTitle: Five things to look out for at the F1 Bahrain GP in Malaysia
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads to Sepang in Malaysia this weekend for the Bahrain Grand Prix, round 16 of the 2026 season and the middle point of a triple header. Due to the ongoing Middle Eastern conflict that forced Bahrain to cancel its grand prix earlier in the year, this marks the first time F1 has raced in the country since 2017.
detailZh: 马来西亚雪邦赛道举办的F1巴林大奖赛五大看点
雪邦赛道本周末代表巴林回归F1赛历
F1将于本周末迎来当前三连赛的中段，在马来西亚举办的巴林大奖赛是2026赛季的第16轮比赛。
由于持续的中东冲突迫使巴林在今年早些时候取消其大奖赛，这是F1自2017年以来首次在该国比赛。
但这并不是唯一的话题，所以以下是在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛上值得关注的五件事。
雪邦曾是F1赛历上的常客，从1999年到2017年每年都举办比赛，之后由于资金不足，马来西亚大奖赛宣告结束。这是一个尤其令人遗憾的时刻，因为多年来雪邦见证了不少经典时刻：无论是2013年红牛那场臭名昭著的“Multi 21”指令事件，还是三年后汉密尔顿的夺冠希望化为泡影，抑或是1999年法拉利通过法院争议性地恢复一、二名完赛成绩。
这也是一条真正考验车手的赛道，两条长直道之间分布着一系列中高速弯角，而这两条长直道正是雪邦的标志性特征。“这条赛道太棒了，”汉密尔顿上周在巴库表示。“它确实能带来精彩的比赛，在决定一年中去哪些赛道比赛时，这应该成为考量因素之一。”
不过由于2026年新规的出台，今年的比赛应该会呈现相当不同的面貌，与巴库的情况类似，车手们必须聪明地选择在哪里释放电池电量，因为那两条长直道很容易耗光全部能量。
还需要考虑吉隆坡非常难以预测的天气，周三曾出现强雷暴，但预计周日会是干燥的。
拉塞尔真的重振状态了吗？
“如果赛季是从今天开始，或者从夏休期开始，我觉得我完全有能力去争斗。”
这是乔治·拉塞尔在杆位赢得阿塞拜疆大奖赛——这是他本赛季的第三个杆位——之后所说的话；而他的梅赛德斯队友安东内利则度过了一个相当混乱的周末，由于在第一节排位中撞车，他从第十六位发车，最终追回到第五名。
这意味着安东内利对第二名拉塞尔的积分领先优势已从81分缩小到66分，但目前赛程只剩下七轮比赛，这位英国车手清楚地知道，他的夺冠希望实际上已经破灭。
“我现在有这么大的差距，”他补充道，“形势可能很快改变。所以，我不会去追那个目标。我要的是赢下每一场比赛，顺其自然吧。”
但是他的暑假说法站得住脚吗？其实并不太站得住脚，因为从那之后他的积分差距实际上又扩大了七分，但不可否认的是，他的表现确实有了明显提升。
他能做的就是把这股势头带进这个周末，不过安东内利对此会有很大发言权，因为在巴库之前，这位20岁的车手在2026年一直表现得毫无失误。“我总是慢一拍。下个周末，我会回到自己的水准，”这位积分榜领跑者在阿塞拜疆立下誓言。
考虑到他今年的状态，人们只能期待情况会是如此。尤其是梅赛德斯还应该会带来期待已久的大规模升级套件。
红牛会表现如何？
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
梅赛德斯为马来西亚站准备的成套升级，对红牛来说恐怕来得不是时候，因为红牛最近才刚刚重新回到前列的争夺之中。这支奥地利车队在过去六场大奖赛中有五场登上了领奖台，包括上周末依靠对小红牛22的升级拿下的双车领奖台——不过这台赛车今年还没有赢过比赛。
但就在差距刚刚缩小之际，如果银箭车队的升级套件奏效，这一劣势可能会再度扩大。马克斯·维斯塔潘表示：“如果他们把升级带到马来西亚，那我们的处境就会变得更艰难一些。”
“如果梅赛德斯带来了升级而且确实有效，那他们就会再领先一步，而这不是你想看到的。这会让夺冠变得更加困难，但我们每个周末都会全力以赴，当然，只要机会出现，我们就会全力去争。”
因此问题来了：红牛是否已经在上周末的巴库错过了2026年最后一个现实的夺冠机会？在那场比赛中，维斯塔潘从第八位发车，展现了极佳的比赛节奏，最终以0.196秒之差位居拉塞尔之后冲线。
这在很大程度上要归功于红牛赛车在巴库那条长直道上的速度表现，而马来西亚也有两条类似的直道，所以本周末他们仍有可能重返竞争行列。但雪邦依然存在一些未知因素，如果梅赛德斯的升级确实兑现了承诺，那么红牛可能又会回到起点。
这个周末可能是一次真正的试金石，检验巴库的速度对红牛来说到底是不是昙花一现。
2027年车手市场的消息本周格外繁忙：阿隆索在周二确认将继续留在F1，随后周三又宣布奥孔将在本赛季结束后离开哈斯。
这两项宣布都不算太令人意外，因为尽管几个月来阿隆索不断被追问自己的未来，这位45岁的车手一直拒绝表态，但据信那只是这位世界冠军施压F1、促使其修改规则的手段——而这套规则正是阿隆索一直公开批评的。
不过，可以预料这位西班牙人会被问及为什么决定留在2027年，尤其是考虑到他的阿斯顿·马丁赛车毫无竞争力，以及他还能坚持多久。但当奥孔还在为自己的前途而战、计划尚未确定时，这无疑是一种奢侈。
这位30岁的车手已经明确表示，他认为过去两年的挣扎源于哈斯赛车表现不稳定，尽管事实上他一直被年轻的队友奥利弗·比尔曼压制。“我是最出色的车手之一，我不怕这么说，”这位曾获得过一场大奖赛胜利的车手上周末如是说。
好吧，现在是时候让他证明了，因为他明年的席位正处于危险之中。本周末F1会看到奥孔重返巅峰状态吗？
诺里斯和科拉平托在巴库赛后会如何回应？
弗朗哥·科拉平托（阿尔派车队）、兰多·诺里斯（迈凯伦车队）、皮埃尔·加斯利（阿尔派车队）
阿塞拜疆大奖赛之后，一个起初令人意外但随后在预料之中的话题，就是弗朗哥·科拉平托、皮埃尔·加斯利与兰多·诺里斯碰撞事故所引发的风波，这导致这位阿根廷车手在雪邦被处以发车位置退后五位的处罚，并遭遇了社交媒体上的谩骂风暴。
诺里斯已经为自己呼吁禁赛科拉平托、并暗示他不配留在一级方程式的言论道歉，他自己也因此成为科拉平托支持者的攻击目标，而阿尔派则在这位阿根廷车手为车队效力的一年半时间里，第四次呼吁停止社交媒体上的辱骂行为。
各方都希望从这起令所有人都颜面扫地的丑陋事件中走出来，但无法回避的是，每当科拉平托与其他车手哪怕发生一点小摩擦，网络上的怒火风暴就会被点燃，这是一级方程式始终存在的问题——而诺里斯在巴库大奖赛之后的公开指责更是让这一问题火上浇油。
在科拉平托毁掉了车队有望双双拿分的机会之后，阿尔派老板弗拉维奥·布里亚托利也暗示会对科拉平托进行队内处罚。鉴于布里亚托利过往的行事风格，这位23岁车手在雪邦周末要面对的，恐怕远不止是帮加斯利洗脏衣服这么简单。
detailEn: Five things to look out for at the F1 Bahrain GP in Malaysia
Sepang makes its F1 return this weekend on behalf of Bahrain
Formula 1 heads to the middle point of its current triple header this weekend with the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia serving as round 16 of the 2026 season.
It marks the first time that F1 will race in the country since 2017 as a result of the ongoing Middle Eastern conflict, which forced Bahrain to cancel its grand prix earlier in the year.
But that is not the only talking point, so here are five things to look out for at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

Sepang was once a staple of the F1 calendar as it featured every year from 1999 to 2017, before a lack of funding caused the end of the Malaysian Grand Prix. It was a particularly disappointing moment because Sepang has been host to several classic moments over the years, whether it be Red Bull’s infamous “Multi 21” moment in 2013, Lewis Hamilton’s title chances blowing up in smoke three years later, or Ferrari controversially having a 1-2 reinstated through the courts in 1999.

It is a real drivers’ track as well, featuring a series of medium-to-high speed corners in between the two long straights that are Sepang’s defining characteristics. “The track is awesome,” said Hamilton in Baku last week. “It’s a track that does give good racing and when it comes to deciding what tracks to go through in the year, that should be a part of the decision-making.”

But the racing this year should look quite different due to the 2026 regulations and in a similar manner to Baku, drivers must be clever with where they deploy their battery power as those two straights could easily swallow up all the energy.
There is also the very unpredictable Kuala Lumpur weather to consider, which saw heavy thunderstorms on Wednesday but Sunday is forecast to be dry.
Is Russell actually rejuvenated?
“If the season had started today, or since the summer break, I feel very much I would have been able to fight.”

Those were the words of George Russell after winning the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole - his third of the season - while it was a much messier weekend for Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who recovered to fifth after starting 16th due to his crash in Q1.

It means Antonelli’s championship lead has reduced from 81 points to 66 over second-placed Russell, but with just seven more rounds currently scheduled, the Briton is well aware that his title hopes are effectively over.
“I’ve got this big deficit,” he added. “It can change quickly. So, I’m not chasing that. I’m chasing to win every race and what will be, will be.”

But does his summer break claim stack up? Not particularly when his points deficit has actually increased by seven since then, yet there can be no denying that his performances have certainly improved.

All he can do is carry that momentum into this weekend, though Antonelli will have a big say in it because until Baku, the 20-year-old had been faultless in 2026. “I was always a step behind. Next weekend, I will be back at my level,” the championship leader vowed in Azerbaijan.
Considering his form this year, one can only expect that to be the case. Especially as Mercedes should also bring its long-awaited large upgrades package.
How will Red Bull fare?
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Mercedes’ raft of upgrades for Malaysia probably comes at a bad time for Red Bull, which only recently managed to pull itself back into the fight at the front. The Austrian outfit has finished on the podium in five of the last six grands prix, including a double podium last weekend thanks to updates for its RB22 - a car that is winless this year.

But just as it had closed the gap, that deficit might once again increase if the Silver Arrows nails its updates. "If they’re bringing an upgrade to Malaysia, then it’s going to look a little bit more difficult for us," said Max Verstappen.

"If Mercedes is bringing an upgrade and it works, then they’ll take another step ahead, and that’s not what you want. It will make it even more difficult to win, but we’ll try every single weekend and, of course, if the opportunity is there, we go for it."

So it begs the question whether Red Bull blew its final realistic opportunity of winning in 2026 at Baku last weekend, where Verstappen crossed the line 0.196s behind Russell after showing sublime race pace from eighth on the grid.

A lot of that was down to the pace the Red Bull teams showed on that long Baku straight and with two similar ones in Malaysia, it could be in the fight again this weekend. But Sepang is still a bit of an unknown and if those Mercedes updates do deliver as promised, then Red Bull may be back to where it started.
This weekend could be a real litmus test for whether the Baku pace was a one-off for Red Bull or not.

Driver market news for 2027 has been particularly busy this week with Fernando Alonso confirming he’ll remain in F1 on Tuesday, before Wednesday’s announcement that Esteban Ocon will depart Haas at the end of the current season.

Neither announcement was that surprising, because although for months Alonso had been quizzed about his future with the 45-year-old refusing to commit, it is believed those were just games from the world champion to increase the pressure on F1 to make tweaks to its regulations. A rule set that Alonso has been a vocal critic of.

Nevertheless, expect quotes from the Spaniard on why he is staying put for 2027, especially considering his uncompetitive Aston Martin car, and just how long he can keep going for. But that is a great luxury to have when Ocon is fighting for his future with his plans yet to be confirmed.

The 30-year-old has made it clear that he thinks his struggles for the past two years have stemmed from an inconsistent Haas car, despite the fact that he has been consistently outperformed by young team-mate Oliver Bearman. “I’m one of the best and I’m not afraid to say it,” the one-time grand prix winner claimed last weekend.
Well, it’s time for him to prove it because his position on next year’s grid is at risk. Will F1 see Ocon return to his former self this weekend?
How will Norris and Colapinto react post-Baku?
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine

One of the surprising but subsequently predictable talking points post-Azerbaijan was the fallout from the Franco Colapinto-Pierre Gasly-Lando Norris clash, which resulted in the Argentine taking a five-place grid penalty to Sepang and a social media storm of abuse.

Norris has apologised for calling for Colapinto to be banned and inferring he shouldn’t be in F1, having become the target of Colapinto’s supporters, while Alpine issued its fourth call to stop social media abuse in the one-and-a-half years the Argentine has driven for the team.

All parties will hope to move on from the ugly incident, which painted nobody in a good light, but there is no escaping the ongoing problem F1 has with the online rage storm that whips up any time Colapinto has even a minor disagreement with another driver – an issue that was only fuelled during the post-Baku call-out by Norris.

Alpine boss Flavio Briatore also hinted at internal team punishment for Colapinto after wiping out its chance of a strong double points finish. Given Briatore’s track record, it’ll be more than making the 23-year-old wash Gasly’s dirty laundry for the Sepang weekend.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Alpine's 2024 F1 car has been turned into the ultimate collector's display
detailZh: 阿尔派的2024年F1赛车部件即将变身终极收藏品展示。F1 Authentics，F1的官方纪念品平台，将开始拍卖一个2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体，配以带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，安装在定制的展示架上。
从阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车中使用的变速箱载体被配对了一个带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，形成了一个不同寻常的收藏品展示。
赛车文化不仅限于赛道。它包括车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车的一部分即将进行拍卖，并且已经被改造成可以放在你客厅的东西。
F1 Authentics，F1官方纪念品平台，正在开启对一款非常酷的2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体以及与其配套的赛车规格后翼的竞拍。变速箱载体上仍保留着其原始的FIA封印，而该翼保留了可工作的DRS襟翼。
这可能会成为你在凝视窗外，一边喝着早晨的咖啡一边沉思时可以依靠的不可思议的东西。
这个组合，是‘奥斯汀拍卖’的一部分，标题为BWT 阿尔派 Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly。其中只有变速箱载体被描述为赛事使用，而后翼是赛车规格部件。
由碳纤维和金属制成，变速箱载体构成了汽车后结构的一部分，而其上方的翼，仍然保持着阿尔派的粉色和蓝色BWT涂装，并在翼尖上印有Castrol品牌，负责管理空气流动并在汽车后部产生下压力。
DRS襟翼仍然可以打开和关闭。当你有访客时，这将是一场令人难以置信的展示。
埃斯蒂班·奥康，阿尔派，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
虽然2024年对阿尔派来说并不是一个完美的赛季，但它确实为当时的全法阵容带来了双料领奖台。
在艰难的开局之后，车队在车手积分榜上排名第六，得益于圣保罗大奖赛上的雨战，埃斯蒂班·奥康获得第二名，皮埃尔·加斯利获得第三名。
detailEn: Alpine's 2024 F1 car has been turned into the ultimate collector's display
A race-used gearbox carrier from Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car has been paired with a race-spec rear wing featuring a working DRS flap for an unusual collector's display
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A piece of Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car is about to go up for auction, and it has been turned into something you could actually put in your living room.

F1 Authentics, the official memorabilia platform of F1, is opening bidding on a very cool 2024 race-used gearbox carrier paired with a race-spec rear wing, mounted together on a custom-built display stand. The gearbox carrier still carries its original FIA seal, and the wing keeps a working DRS flap.
It could make for an incredible thing to lean on while you look soulfully out of the window drinking your morning coffee.

The lot, that makes up part of 'The Austin Auction,' is titled the BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly. Only the gearbox carrier is described as race-used; the rear wing is a race-specification part.

Made from carbon fibre and metal, the gearbox carrier forms part of the car's rear structure while the wing above it, still in Alpine's pink-and-blue BWT livery with Castrol branding on the endplates, manages airflow and creates downforce at the rear of the car.
The DRS flap can still be opened and closed. And what an incredible showing that would be for when you have visitors.
Esteban Ocon, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
While 2024 wasn't the perfect season for Alpine, it did result in a double podium for the then-all-French lineup.
After a difficult start, the team finished sixth in the constructors' standings, helped by a wet race at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, where Esteban Ocon finished second and Pierre Gasly third.

法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
